dispute_posted.meaning: a user has posted a dispute bond (disputeAmount) in disputeToken

dispute_valid.meaning: the dispute is objectively valid because the Merkle tree update is incorrect

disputer_blacklisted.meaning: the disputer address is blacklisted on the blacklist-capable disputeToken during the dispute period

bond_refunded_to_disputer.meaning: the dispute bond (disputeAmount) is refunded to the disputer
bond_refunded_to_disputer.checkpoint: at Governor resolution of a valid dispute

tree_reverted.meaning: the incorrect Merkle tree update is reverted as part of resolving the dispute as valid
tree_reverted.checkpoint: at Governor resolution of a valid dispute

recorded_resolution_valid.meaning: the on-chain DisputeResolved event records the dispute outcome as valid (true)

assumptions: The dispute bond is posted in disputeToken and the dispute is objectively valid before the Governor resolves it.
The disputer's blacklisting occurs during the dispute period and is not controlled by the disputer per the report.
The Governor's resolution is the on-chain record of the dispute outcome.

unresolved.description: Report does not state whether resolveDispute(false) transfers the bond to the Governor or merely records the outcome; the forced_falsification impact concerns only the recorded DisputeResolved(false) event, which is formalized here.
Report does not specify the exact disputeAmount value or token decimals; not needed for the event-accuracy relation.

limitations: Formalizes only the forced_falsification impact (incorrect DisputeResolved(false) event for a valid dispute); the unfair_confiscation impact is handled in a separate claim pass.
The relation is stated at the level of the recorded resolution outcome; the report does not give a numeric encoding of the event payload.
